subject: Finexa — security evidence & buying-process recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Morris <jenna.morris@finexa.com>, Nate Lin <nate.lin@finexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 15:14:00 -0800
Subject: Finexa — security evidence & buying-process recap

Hi Jenna / Nate —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

What we heard from your side:
- Primary use: customer-facing semantic search and chat across underwriting docs (low PII footprint).
- Decision criteria: latency under 250ms tail for 90% queries, deterministic data controls (VPC/KMS), unit cost targets.
- Buying process: Security review (SOC 2 + pen test + audit logs) -> Legal redlines -> Procurement PO (target mid-Apr).

Stakeholder mapping (as I understand it):
- Product/PM sponsor: Jenna Morris
- Security/Trust: Nate Lin
- Procurement/commercial: internal procurement team (TBD, will share contacts)
- Economic buyer: VP of Engineering (we should get name if possible)

As next steps I can: 
1) Share SOC 2 + pen test summary + sample audit logs and data retention policy (we’ll redact customer-specific details).
2) Map the internal steps and ownership for legal/procurement with Ben (we’ll align on any SOW/contract language that tends to come up).
3) Book a 30-minute follow-up with your security and procurement folks next week to walk through evidence and timelines.

Can you confirm the procurement timeline (when would you need pricing and contract terms to sign by mid-Apr?), and whether we should send evidence to anyone else on your security team?

I’ll prepare the evidence bundle and loop Ben on pricing questions.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Jenna Morris <jenna.morris@finexa.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Finexa — security evidence & buying-process recap

Thanks for the recap, Marissa — this is very helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement timeline: we'd like to have commercial terms agreed and PO submitted by the week of April 12. That gives us time for internal budget approvals.
- Security stakeholders: Nate Lin (cc'd) is our security lead; he may bring in one additional engineer (TBD) to review audit logs and SSO/KMS details.
- Legal: our counsel prefers we surface any data residency or subprocessing details up front.

Can you send SOC 2 (redacted), pen test high-level summary, and a small sample of audit logs (obfuscated) + your data retention policy? We'll start internal review once we have those.

Also we may need answers to a couple quick questions:
1) Do you support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM)?
2) What is your standard retention period for request logs and how long are KV caches persisted?

If you can get those to us by early next week, we'll schedule a 30-minute session with Nate and procurement.

Best,
Jenna
Jenna Morris
Director of Product, Finexa
jenna.morris@finexa.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Finexa — security evidence & buying-process recap

Ben / Rishi — forwarding Finexa's asks. Quick internal plan: 

Ben: can you put together a commercial cadence + draft pricing we should present to procurement? They want PO submitted by week of Apr 12. Also note they care about unit cost targets and predictable dedicated capacity options.

Rishi: need your help on two technical Qs from Jenna: 
- Do we support customer-managed KMS/HSM options for Private deployments and what level of detail can we provide to them?
- Confirm retention policies: standard request logs retention window and KV cache persistence defaults, plus any configurable options.

I'll package SOC2/pen test and redacted logs and send to their security inbox early next week. Also scheduling 30m with their security/procurement for Tues/Thurs next week — suggestions below.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Morris <jenna.morris@finexa.com>, Nate Lin <nate.lin@finexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Finexa — security evidence bundle and next steps

Hi Jenna / Nate —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our discussion, attached is the redacted evidence bundle and a short Q&A for the security review. Attachments (redacted):
- SOC2_Type2_2025_redacted.pdf (summarizes scope of our SOC 2, controls tested, and contact for auditor)
- pen_test_summary_2025.pdf (high-level findings and remediation status)
- sample_audit_logs_2026-02.csv (obfuscated sample showing event types / timestamps)
- data_retention_policy.pdf (policy + configurable retention windows)

Quick answers to your two questions: 
1) KMS/HSM: For Redwood Private we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and HW-backed HSM for on-prem. For Hosted API we offer envelope encryption and customer-managed keys on enterprise plans — we can provide an architecture diagram in the security call.
2) Retention: by default request logs are retained for 90 days; audit logs can be exported and retained long-term on customer storage. KV cache persistence is ephemeral per-deployment (configurable TTL; default 24 hours). We can offer extended retention via Dedicated/Private options.

Next steps proposed: 
- Security call: Tue Mar 3, 10:00-10:30 PT (we've reserved; please confirm)
- Commercial/pricing review with procurement: Thu Mar 5, 09:00-09:30 PT
- I'll upload the full artifacts to a shared drive and send a DocuSign NDA template if they prefer.

Links: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/finexa/security-evidence
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-34821

Let me know if you need anything else ahead of the call.

Cheers,
Marissa

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_2025_redacted.pdf, pen_test_summary_2025.pdf, sample_audit_logs_2026-02.csv, data_retention_policy.pdf
